user.title: Set up Jacket Advisor
user.description: Choose only the context you actually want to use. Weather is the only required input; indoor, work and shift context are optional.

basic.name: Basics
basic.description: Weather and optionally a representative living-room temperature for the indoor-to-outdoor transition.

data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity for the current location. Hourly forecasts improve the later/take-with-you recommendation.
data_description.indoor_temperature: Optional representative comfort room, for example the living room. Deliberately unusually warm rooms are less suitable.
data_description.fallback_indoor_temperature: Used when no indoor sensor is selected or when it is temporarily unavailable.
data_description.rain_advice: Assesses precipitation risk separately from warmth. Weather forecasts are never retrained from user feedback.

context.name: Time context (optional)
context.description: A selected calendar can use start/end times only to indicate that a later period may be relevant. Title, description and location are not interpreted.

data_description.context_calendar_entity: Only timed events are considered. An event is explicitly not treated as proof that you are outdoors.

work.name: Work context (optional)
work.description: Optional work location. Work context becomes active only when a weather source for work is selected. Then Monday-Friday 08:00–17:00 is assumed by default; shift workers can use the rotating cycle below instead.

data_description.work_zone: Existing Home Assistant zone for context and display. Weather itself comes from the separate weather entity.
data_description.work_weather_entity: Optional weather source for a work location with significantly different conditions. The selected work model is only applied when this weather source is configured.
data_description.work_mode: Normal 5-day week uses Monday-Friday. Rotating shift system uses the cycle configured below. “Do not consider work” disables automatic work assumptions.
data_description.workday_start: Default 08:00. The 30-minute buffer before this time is only for planning; current work weather starts at the actual work time.
data_description.workday_end: Default 17:00. The 30-minute buffer after this time is only for planning; current work weather ends at the actual work time.
data_description.vacation_calendar_entity: Optional. Calendar contents are not interpreted; overlapping periods only suppress otherwise probable work.

shift.name: Rotating shift system (only if needed)
shift.description: Use only when “Rotating shift system” is selected as work model. Example: F,F,S,S,N,N,N,X,X. F = early, S = late, N = night, X = off.

data_description.shift_pattern: Comma-separated sequence using F, S, N and X. The cycle repeats independently of the weekday.
data_description.shift_anchor_date: Date on which the first item in the shift sequence applies.

shared.name: Shared wall tablet
shared.description: Allowed HA accounts are automatically recognized by the card as shared control devices and do not get their own thermal profile.

data_description.shared_user_ids: These accounts select an existing user profile in the card first. Normal users remain restricted to their own profile.

error.invalid_shift_pattern: The rotating shift system requires a sequence containing only F, S, N and X separated by commas.
error.shift_anchor_required: The rotating shift system requires an anchor date.
error.work_weather_required: An enabled work context requires a weather source for the work location.
error.invalid_work_time: Work start and end must be different times.
error.invalid_shift_time: Each shift must have different start and end times.
